item.description:

item.title: Philosophical Poetry
item.description:
On Socrates

Greek Anthology 7.96, attributed to Diogenes Laertius

Drink now, Socrates, in the house of Zeus.
Truly a god called you wise,
and Wisdom herself is divine.
From the Athenians you received only hemlock;
but they drank it themselves through your mouth.

Against the Fear of Death
